css.note: The website reads the generated CSS. The app still holds these values as literals in src/ui.rs and src/window.rs, which must match this file; generating src/tokens.rs and wiring the app to it is still to do.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Theme input. The window's ground, and the website's page. Read from background in colors.toml; this is the built-in fallback (Palette::default, src/ui.rs).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Theme input, made readable on background, key and key-held. The result, digits and the focus ring in the app; headings and body text on the website.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Theme input (accent, else color4, else foreground). The = key's fill, and on the website the primary button's fill and links on background.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Derived: background 65% of the way to foreground, made readable on background. The expression line; on the website secondary text, captions and the secondary button's border.

tokens.name: function
tokens.usage: Derived: muted made readable on key and key-held. The C, ±, % and ⌫ labels; on the website comments in code blocks.

tokens.name: operator
tokens.usage: Derived: accent made readable on key and key-held. The ÷ × − + labels; on the website the $ prompt in code blocks.

tokens.name: key
tokens.usage: Derived: background 8% towards foreground (6% on a light theme). Key fills; on the website cards, code blocks and the secondary button's fill, and 1 px dividers.

tokens.name: key-held
tokens.usage: Derived: background 18% towards foreground (14% light). A held key; on the website a hovered or pressed secondary button.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Derived: background or foreground, whichever reads better on accent, made readable on it. The = label; the primary button's text on the website.

tokens.name: accent-held
tokens.usage: Derived: accent 25% away from on-accent (lighter under a dark label). A held =; the primary button hovered or pressed on the website.

tokens.name: notice
tokens.usage: Derived: accent made readable on background. "Copied" in place of the expression line.

tokens.name: icon-tile
tokens.usage: The app icon's tile (packaging/icons/com.aliasproject.calc.svg). Icon and favicon only, never UI.

tokens.name: icon-corner
tokens.usage: The icon's corner: amber, Alias Calc's colour in the Alias app family. Icon and favicon only, never UI or text.

tokens.name: icon-glyph
tokens.usage: The four operators drawn on the icon tile. Icon only.

families.name: mono
families.usage: The only family. The app compiles 9 KB subsets of Light and Regular into the binary (fonts/); the website self-hosts full JetBrains Mono woff2 files (OFL) in Light, Regular and SemiBold.

groups.name: app
groups.usage: Logical px at the aliasOS default text size (12 px). Every size scales by base-size ÷ 12, from 0.75 to 2 (src/textsize.rs).

styles.name: result
styles.usage: The result (DISPLAY_SIZE). Shrinks to fit the width, down to result-min and further rather than clip a digit.

styles.name: result-min
styles.usage: The smallest the result shrinks before it would clip (DISPLAY_MIN_SIZE).

styles.name: expression-min
styles.usage: The smallest the expression line shrinks before it drops characters from the start behind … (EXPRESSION_MIN_SIZE).

styles.name: key-label
styles.usage: Digit and function labels (KEY_SIZE), capped at half the key's height.

styles.name: operator-label
styles.usage: ÷ × − + = at KEY_SIZE × 1.3, since JetBrains Mono draws operators small next to its digits; 28.8 at the default window, from the half-height cap.

groups.name: web
groups.usage: The website (site/, github.io). Sizes are px at a 16 px root; the CSS writes them in rem, so text follows the browser's font size.

styles.name: web-hero
styles.usage: The hero line, in the result's Light weight. web-hero-narrow under 640 px wide.

styles.name: web-hero-narrow
styles.usage: The hero line under 640 px wide, so it fits a phone at 200% text.

styles.name: web-stat
styles.usage: Benchmark figures (3.0 ms, 2.4 MiB): the result style, smaller.

styles.name: web-title
styles.usage: Card titles, the wordmark in the header.

styles.name: web-small
styles.usage: Card text, table cells, captions, nav links, buttons.

styles.name: web-code
styles.usage: Install commands and key names in code blocks.

styles.name: web-label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and table heads, in capitals. Also the canvas boards' panel labels.

tokens.name: window-padding
tokens.usage: The window's padding around the display and keypad (PADDING, src/ui.rs).

tokens.name: key-gap
tokens.usage: Between keys, and between the display and the keypad (GAP).

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: The focus ring's gap from its key, inside the 6 px between keys (FOCUS_OFFSET); the same on the website.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Website: inside badges, between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Website: between buttons, between an icon and its text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Website: list rows, small card gaps (the window padding).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Website: code block padding, gaps in a grid of cards on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Website: card padding, gaps in a grid of cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Website: page side padding on phones; between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Website: page side padding from 640 px wide; between sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Website: between sections (space-12 on phones, under 640 px wide).

tokens.name: key-radius
tokens.usage: Key corners (RADIUS, src/ui.rs), near the 2 px aliasOS windows use. On the website: buttons, cards, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Website: badges and key caps in text, square like aliasOS windows.

tokens.name: window-width
tokens.usage: The width the window opens at (DEFAULT_SIZE, src/window.rs), scaled with the text size.

tokens.name: window-height
tokens.usage: The height the window opens at (DEFAULT_SIZE).

tokens.name: window-min-width
tokens.usage: The narrowest the window goes (MIN_SIZE), chosen to keep key-min.

tokens.name: window-min-height
tokens.usage: The shortest the window goes (MIN_SIZE).

tokens.name: key-min
tokens.usage: The smallest a key gets either way (MIN_KEY): the house touch-target rule. Also every website control's minimum height.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: The focus ring's width, in foreground (FOCUS_WIDTH); the same on the website.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Website: the widest the page's content gets.

tokens.name: rule-width
tokens.usage: Website: the width of decorative dividers (header and footer rules, the line above each benchmark figure) and the secondary button's border, drawn in key or muted.

tokens.name: notice-time
tokens.usage: How long "Copied" shows (NOTICE_TIME, src/window.rs). No fade: it appears and goes.

tokens.name: repeat-delay
tokens.usage: Backspace repeat delay when the compositor doesn't send one (DEFAULT_REPEAT).

tokens.name: repeat-interval
tokens.usage: Backspace repeat rate when the compositor doesn't send one (DEFAULT_REPEAT).

tokens.name: display-share
tokens.usage: The share of the window's height above the keypad (DISPLAY_SHARE).

tokens.name: operator-scale
tokens.usage: Operator and = labels against KEY_SIZE.

tokens.name: label-cap
tokens.usage: The most of a key's height its label may take.

tokens.name: key-mix-dark
tokens.usage: key: how far background moves towards foreground on a dark theme (0.06 light, key-mix-light).

tokens.name: key-mix-light
tokens.usage: key on a light theme.

tokens.name: key-held-mix-dark
tokens.usage: key-held on a dark theme (0.14 light).

tokens.name: key-held-mix-light
tokens.usage: key-held on a light theme.

tokens.name: muted-mix
tokens.usage: muted: how far background moves towards foreground before readable().

tokens.name: accent-held-mix
tokens.usage: accent-held: how far accent moves away from its label.

tokens.name: text-scale-min
tokens.usage: The smallest text-size factor followed (src/textsize.rs).

tokens.name: text-scale-max
tokens.usage: The largest text-size factor followed: WCAG 1.4.4's 200%.

tokens.name: mono-advance
tokens.usage: Website: JetBrains Mono's advance width in em, so a drawn window can shrink its result to fit its width, as the app does.

contrast.usage: The result; website headings and body text.
Digit labels; website text in cards and code blocks.
A held digit; a hovered secondary button's text.
The expression line; website secondary text and captions.
Website: secondary text in cards and badges.
The = label; the website's primary button.
A held =; the primary button hovered or pressed.
The focus ring, app and website (1.4.11).
